# FG-KNOW-0002

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`search-index`](../../ops/runbooks/search-index.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `oversized_description_is_truncated_and_logged` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 検索の索引を更新できませんでした。管理者に問い合わせ番号を伝えてください。
- en: The search index could not be updated. Give the request ID to your administrator.
- id: Indeks pencarian tidak dapat diperbarui. Berikan ID permintaan kepada administrator Anda.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 20 K2 (ADR-0040): one entry, or one project's entries, of the search index could not be written as asked, or not completely: `reason=truncated` (an entry's body is over 256 KB or its vector over 50 000 terms: the rest is not searchable, the row says `truncated`), `reason=subtree_too_large` (a group move or user rename touched more projects than one subscriber step refreshes: the rest keep their old path in the index until the rebuild and are recorded `failed` with this code in forge.search_index_state), `reason=write_failed` (the rebuild could not write one project's entries; the cause is chained). Plan 20 K4 (documents of the default branch, the `search.index_documents` job): `reason=read_bound` (the tip's documents were read in part — a `forge_checks::doc_lint` bound `doc_tree` / `doc_files` / `doc_large_files` / `doc_bytes` / `doctype_files`, as the document API's `incomplete`: what was read is indexed, every other document row is left `confidential`), `reason=read_failed` (the job failed for good: git, storage or the database; the cause is chained), `reason=key_too_long` (a document path over 1024 bytes: not indexed). The index is derived: nothing a person wrote is lost.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event (`forge.search.index_item`) carries `reason`, `source_kind`, `project_id`, `source_key` (a project: empty; a merge request: its iid), `limit` and the source event's `request_id` / `seq` (subscriber) or the rebuild's request_id. forge.search_index_state holds the project's last `state` and `last_error_code` and `attempts`. A failed subscriber step itself is FG-DB-0008 (subscriber `search-index`, runbook subscriber-lag). Documents: the event carries `bound` (read_bound), `sha` and `cause_code` / `cause` (read_failed); the state row has `indexed_sha` NULL until a complete read, so the next push reads the whole tip again. The job's own runs are in forge.jobs (`kind = 'search.index_documents'`, payload `project_id`, `full`).

## 対処 (fix)

`truncated`: nothing to repair (the entry stays searchable by its title and first 256 KB); shorten the source if it matters. `subtree_too_large`: run `forge search reindex` (runbook search-index). `write_failed`: fix the chained cause, then `forge search reindex --project <id>`. `read_bound`: the repository holds more documents than one read takes (runbook search-index: split it, or raise the bound in a change); the unread ones stay withheld from AI and searchable only by their old text. `read_failed`: fix the chained cause (runbook of its code), then push again or `forge search reindex --project <id>` (it enqueues a full documents job).
